configure_hornet_small_backbone: configure a HorNet small backbone with drop_path_rate 0.4 for image classification
configure_linear_cls_head: configure a LinearClsHead with 1000 classes and 768 input channels for classification
configure_label_smoothing_loss: configure LabelSmoothLoss with smoothing value 0.1 in original mode for the classification head
configure_mixup_cutmix_augments: configure Mixup and CutMix data augmentation with alpha values 0.8 and 1.0 for training
configure_model_initialization: configure TruncNormal and Constant initialization for Linear, LayerNorm, and LayerScale layers
